_about: Sources the Detail Library can pull public-domain architectural details from. Each file added to images/raw/ carries a licence tag (Public domain, CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA) in images/raw/licences.json. 'reachable_from_sandbox' records what the build sandbox could reach on the test date; a False value means download manually or from a machine with access. Lower priority number = try first.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.licence_filter: imageinfo extmetadata LicenseShortName contains 'Public domain', 'CC0' or 'PD'
good_for: HABS measured drawings (US government, public domain)
Navy and DPLA architectural sections and details
sources.pull_method: commons API search, then file download
sources.download_status: API works. Original-file host returned HTTP 429 and thumbnail host is refused by the proxy, as of 2026-11-07.

sources.name: Library of Congress HABS/HAER
sources.licence_filter: US government work, public domain per LoC (confirm on each record)
good_for: Measured architectural drawings, sections and details (1933 onward)
sources.note: Many of the same HABS drawings are mirrored on Wikimedia Commons.

sources.name: The Met Open Access
good_for: Architectural drawings and plans in the department of Drawings and Prints
sources.pull_method: API search with departmentId, then primaryImage URL
sources.download_status: Not reachable from sandbox (not in egress allowlist).

sources.name: Art Institute of Chicago Open Access
good_for: Architectural drawings, including the Chicago Architects Design holdings
sources.pull_method: API search, then IIIF image URL
sources.download_status: Not reachable from sandbox (not in egress allowlist).

sources.name: Smithsonian Open Access
sources.licence_filter: CC0 designation per item (check each record)
good_for: Architectural drawings in NMAH, NMAAHC and archives collections
sources.download_status: Not reachable from sandbox. Needs a key from api.data.gov.

sources.name: Internet Archive
sources.licence_filter: pre-1929 US publications (public domain); check each item's licenseurl
good_for: Radford, Portfolio of Details of Building Construction (1911)

sources.name: NREL and DOE building publications
sources.licence_filter: US federal work, public domain; third-party material inside a report may be copyrighted
good_for: Building America and building-envelope details, wall and roof assemblies

sources.name: NIST publications
sources.licence_filter: US federal work, public domain; check for copyrighted third-party figures
good_for: Building envelope and flashing test reports (NBS Report 2683 and related)

sources.name: Manufacturer detail libraries (Sika, GAF, Carlisle, Tremco, others)
sources.licence_filter: NOT public domain. Excluded from images/raw. Link only, in reference/csi/ JSON files.

sources.name: Open-access research papers (journals, repositories)
sources.licence_filter: CC BY or CC BY-SA only (check licence per article)
good_for: Building-envelope research with detail drawings and assembly diagrams
sources.pull_method: manual, or repository API (e.g. Crossref licence metadata)

sources.name: University open educational resources and course notes
sources.licence_filter: CC BY or CC BY-SA only (check each course page)
good_for: Construction and detailing course material, studio drawings

sources.name: Trade association and manufacturer downloads (open licence only)
sources.licence_filter: Only where the publisher states CC BY or CC BY-SA. Default is all rights reserved: link only.
sources.licence_tag: CC BY / CC BY-SA (only if stated)
good_for: Wall, roof and joint details where the publisher has licensed them openly

sources.name: Architectural graphic standards (Architectural Graphic Standards, Neufert and similar)
sources.licence_filter: Excluded. Current editions are all rights reserved.
